corrections.problem: Cited passage says day/night cycles and clocks synchronize the population’s perception; it does not call the synchronized object the material world.
corrections.action: Removed unsupported “and the material world” scope.

corrections.problem: The cited account concerns three specific Suzy ships, not the full Suzy class.
corrections.action: Narrowed to Swaruu’s, Dhor Káal’el’s, and Chiqui’s ships.

corrections.problem: The cited source says the Giza city exists below the plateau; it is separate temple structures and embellishments that were fabricated or repurposed.
corrections.action: Clarified the city’s existence and narrowed fabrication to structures and decor.

corrections.problem: The source qualifies the body choice: Yazhi says she no longer needs reproduction because she is simultaneous across time.
corrections.action: Added the qualification while retaining the stated reason of helping others relate to her.

corrections.problem: Conflated icy asteroid-belt material with Tiamat’s water; source distinguishes it from solid planetary remnants.
corrections.action: Narrowed to icy belt debris and separate solid remnants.

corrections.problem: “Empathic” adds an unsupported qualifier to the cited high-vibration/positive-star-seed category.
corrections.action: Changed to positive starseeds, matching the source description.

corrections.problem: Misattributed suspicion of the official explanation to the Urmah; Mari says her side suspects the opposite and predicts Urmah disbelief.
corrections.action: Reattributed the suspicion and retained the official rationale as an attributed claim.

corrections.problem: The account does not establish that the omitted cleaning caused the black widow; it says the ship had never visited the surface.
corrections.action: Separated the cleaning protocol from the spider discovery and retained the reported unknown origin.
